claims.text: The trace-governed excess clears both POL-RD-01 gates. The gps_trace records 16.2 km between the pickup event and the dropoff event against a booked optimal of 12.0 km, an excess of 4.2 km — 35% of optimal — so the excess is both greater than 20% of the optimal distance and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace-governs rule requires me to cite gps_trace.trace_distance_km rather than the trip_record's rounded convenience copy of the same measurement; both happen to read 16.2 km here.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met: the artifacts describe the same trip. Trip identifier TRP-09111 appears on the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown, and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-18T08:05:00+08:00 matches the trip_record's started_at of 2026-09-18T08:05:00+08:00.

The rider carries no repeat-claimant taint: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 rule requiring corroboration beyond the gps_trace for a low-excess claim by a frequent claimant is not engaged, and the excess rests on the trace alone. No other field on either profile is relied on for this point.

The trace is clean for policy purposes and POL-RD-07 consequences are not triggered: 205 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec of 0.0 over a disputed segment lasting 34 minutes. The excess can therefore be measured from the trace itself and needs no independent corroboration.

No traffic advisory exists in the bundle, so the driver cannot invoke POL-RD-03. EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0 — with the note that no traffic advisory matched the booked route and trip window. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory naming a closed road or junction on the optimal route, with a validity window overlapping the trace and a corridor departure and rejoin; the record supplies none of the three, and the absence of the artifact is itself citable.

The chat log defeats any rider-requested-detour defence under POL-RD-04. At 08:12:00 the rider wrote 'The navigation route was left after Pioneer Road. Please return to the booked route.' and at 08:12:35 the driver replied 'I am following the road ahead.' There is no rider instruction to detour, neither message carries a waypoint_hint, and the driver's reply is a refusal to rejoin the booked route rather than a direction to follow — so the rider-instruction limb of POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record.

No endpoint amendment occurred, so POL-RD-05's re-quote route is closed to the driver: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip_record and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. The deviation must therefore be measured against the booked 12.0 km optimal, not an amended one.

This is not a pooled trip, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply: trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. The baseline for POL-RD-01 is the booked 12.0 km optimal.

The refund route is the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, not POL-RD-11: fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so this is not an upfront-quoted trip and no distance-or-time refund is closed off. The recomputation runs as follows — ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.2), the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route - 1.00 promo_discount = 24.224 recomputed_fare. Charged total is 33.36, so the refund is 33.36 - 24.224 = 9.136, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 9.15 — the exact sum the rider contested. It is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND.

The SGD 2.00 Tuas South Avenue 8 loop gantry is carried in the fare_breakdown as on_optimal_route false, and the POL-RD-02 refund above already credits only the SGD 1.00 Pioneer Road inbound gantry lying on the optimal route. Under POL-RD-09(1) the off-route ERP is itemised separately for transparency but must NEVER be added on top of the 9.15 refund, because it is already comprehended in it.

claims.text: The driver's answer on this record is a road-condition defence — 'I followed the road available to me' — which is the external-event exoneration of POL-RD-03, and that clause requires a traffic_advisory. The only traffic-advisory artifact on this case, EV-ADVIS-09111-01, is MISSING from the pool: it carries no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0 and the BLOCKING issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment expressly rather than presenting the artifact as clean. POL-RD-10(5) makes that precise situation a mandatory escalation ground — an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool, the clause's own example being 'a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory'. On that basis the tribunal should not enter a final money ruling: under POL-GEN-03 the disputed SGD 9.15 is held for human review rather than refunded, which is the outcome most faithful to the state of this record.

Even taking the rider's case at its highest on the trace the policy says governs, the excess is 4.2 km — 35.0% of the 12.0 km optimal route. That clears the establishment gate under POL-RD-01 (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km) but sits below both materiality gates (more than 50% of optimal, more than 8.0 km). The deviation is therefore not MATERIAL, and POL-RD-06 is not engaged on its own terms: no driver_profile consultation, no FULL_REFUND uplift of charged_total of SGD 33.36, and no driver-conduct referral arises from this trip.

There is in any event no repeat-deviation pattern to load onto the driver. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 610, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 test (3 or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more on at least 40 completed trips) is satisfied. Under POL-GEN-01 the rest of the profile — rating, account age, lifetime trips, cancellation rate, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter — is context only and can ground no adverse finding, so the driver profile yields the rider nothing on this trip.

The rider's separate complaint about 'an extra ERP charge' cannot be paid twice. The off-route gantry 'Tuas South Avenue 8 loop' (SGD 2.00, on_optimal_route false) is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 recomputation, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding that pass-through line on top of the distance-and-time refund; the 'Pioneer Road inbound' gantry (SGD 1.00, on_optimal_route true) lies on the optimal route and is properly chargeable. The rider's recovery is one figure, not distance plus ERP.

The fare model on this trip is METERED, so POL-RD-02 is the only route to a rider refund and it caps the exposure: charged_total is SGD 33.36; recomputed_fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x the 1.2 surge_multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route + 0.00 waiting fee - 1.00 promo discount = SGD 24.224; the refund is 33.36 - 24.224 = 9.136, rounded up to SGD 9.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so at most a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.15 is available and no larger sum is traceable to any line of the fare_breakdown.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties, on trip TRP-09111.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (EV-GPS-09111): 16.2 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 12.0 km (EV-TRIP-09111) — an excess of 4.2 km, or 35% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 gates (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). It reaches neither materiality gate (more than 50% or more than 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged: no driver-profile test, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise from this trip. I make no adverse use of either profile (POL-GEN-01).

NO EXCULPATION APPLIES. (1) The driver's account, 'I followed the road available to me', is a general assertion that cites no evidence. Under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke an exculpatory clause, and a general assertion unsupported by a traffic-advisory ID does not discharge that burden; it carries no weight and is discarded. POL-RD-03 was therefore not invoked against a cited artifact, and the mandatory-escalation ground in POL-RD-10(5) is NOT engaged. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-09111-01, is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, code MISSING_ARTIFACT — which is citable as the absence of any advisory, but absence of the artifact a clause would need is not the same as a clause invoked against a cited absent artifact, and an uncited denial does not manufacture an escalation. (2) The chat log (EV-CHAT-09111) shows the rider asking to rejoin the booked route and the driver declining; there was no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04). (3) No endpoint was amended (POL-RD-05). (4) The trip is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12). (5) The fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not close off the distance-and-time refund.

THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). Charged total from EV-FARE-09111: SGD 33.36. Recomputed fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.2 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route − 1.00 promo discount = SGD 24.224. Refund = 33.36 − 24.224 = SGD 9.136, payable rounded up to SGD 9.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and below 90% of the charged total, so the outcome is a partial refund.

THE ERP POINT. The SGD 2.00 'Tuas South Avenue 8 loop' gantry (on_optimal_route false) is already comprehended in the recomputed fare, which credits only the SGD 1.00 on-optimal-route gantry; under POL-RD-09(1) it is itemised for transparency and is NOT added on top of the SGD 9.15. It is not a phantom line — the vehicle crossed it on the detour — so no billing-integrity referral arises.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown, chat log) has weight_multiplier 1.0, so the cap under POL-GEN-02(2) is 1.0; the missing advisory carries no deciding fact and does not move the cap. Confidence is recorded at 0.90.
